_note: Chapter 01 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: After the storm, the fishermen had to abandon their boats and rebuild the nets.
ex.cn: 风暴过后，渔民们不得不弃船，重新编织渔网。
ex.note: abandon oneself to 沉溺于；abandon a plan 放弃计划

ex.en: The two sides finally reached an accord after eleven hours of talk.
ex.cn: 谈了十一个小时之后，双方终于达成了一项协议。
ex.note: in accord with 与…一致；reach an accord 达成协议

ex.en: The chairman accorded the guests a warm welcome.
ex.cn: 主席给了客人们热情的欢迎。
ex.note: accord sb. sth. = give sb. sth. 给予某人某物

ex.en: The pain in her left ear was so acute that she could not sleep.
ex.cn: 她左耳的疼痛如此剧烈，以至于无法入睡。
ex.note: acute pain 剧痛；an acute sense of humour 敏锐的幽默感

ex.en: We cannot afford to waste another minute of this fine weather.
ex.cn: 这么好的天气，我们浪费不起一分钟。
ex.note: afford sth. to sb. 负担得起某物给某人

ex.en: The teacher allowed us to leave early on Friday.
ex.cn: 老师允许我们周五提前离开。
ex.note: allow for 考虑到；allow sb. to do 允许某人做

ex.en: Her analysis of the market data won the team a place in the final.
ex.cn: 她对市场数据的分析为团队赢得了决赛席位。
ex.note: an analysis of … 对…的分析

ex.en: The cat is not anywhere in the house.
ex.cn: 猫在屋子里哪儿都找不到。
ex.note: anywhere but 除…之外哪儿都；anywhere else 别处

ex.en: The campus was designed to blend modern architecture with the old fishing town.
ex.cn: 校园的设计把现代建筑与那座老渔镇融合在了一起。

ex.en: It is hard to assess the damage before the storm has fully passed.
ex.cn: 在风暴完全过去之前，很难评估损失。
ex.note: assess the damage / risk / impact 评估损失/风险/影响

ex.en: He attributed his success to hard work rather than luck.
ex.cn: 他把成功归因于努力，而不是运气。
ex.note: attribute A to B 把 A 归因于 B

ex.en: Patience is an important attribute of a good teacher.
ex.cn: 耐心是一位好老师的重要特征。
ex.note: an attribute of … …的一个特征

ex.en: He was badly shaken by the news of the accident.
ex.cn: 事故的消息让他大为震惊。
ex.note: badly + 过去分词 = 非常/严重地；badly needed 非常需要的

ex.en: The river has formed a wide basin where it meets the sea.
ex.cn: 这条河入海处冲积出一片宽阔的流域。

ex.en: A beggar sat by the station gate, holding out an empty bowl.
ex.cn: 一个乞丐坐在车站门口，捧着一只空碗。

ex.en: Two local companies bid for the construction contract.
ex.cn: 两家本地公司为这份建筑合同出价竞标。
ex.note: bid farewell to 告别（正文用到的就是这个义项）；bid for 竞标

ex.en: She wore a white blouse and a dark skirt to the ceremony.
ex.cn: 她穿着白衬衫和深色裙子去参加典礼。

ex.en: The boundary between the two counties runs along the river.
ex.cn: 两县的分界线沿着这条河延伸。
ex.note: push the boundary 突破边界

ex.en: Every student in the hall felt like a brother to him.
ex.cn: 礼堂里的每个学生对他来说都像兄弟。

ex.en: We booked a small cabin in the mountains for the weekend.
ex.cn: 我们在山里订了一间小木屋过周末。

ex.en: The photo captured the exact moment the runners crossed the line.
ex.cn: 这张照片恰好捕捉到赛跑选手冲过终点线的那一刻。
ex.note: capture sb.'s attention 吸引某人的注意

ex.en: The escaping prisoner was finally captured near the harbour.
ex.cn: 那名越狱的囚犯最终在港口附近被抓捕归案。

ex.en: He approached the cliff edge with great caution.
ex.cn: 他极其谨慎地靠近悬崖边缘。
ex.note: with caution 谨慎地

ex.en: The doctor cautioned him against running too fast after the operation.
ex.cn: 医生告诫他手术后不要跑得太快。
ex.note: caution sb. against sth. 告诫某人不要做某事

ex.en: The station was in complete chaos after the power failed.
ex.cn: 停电之后，车站陷入一片混乱。

ex.en: Smoke rose from the chimney of the old bakery.
ex.cn: 烟从那家老面包房的烟囱里升起。

ex.en: Books here are classified by subject, not by the year they were published.
ex.cn: 这里的书按主题分类，而不是按出版年份。

ex.en: The fog rolled in from the coast just after sunrise.
ex.cn: 日出后不久，雾就从海岸那边涌了进来。

ex.en: The building was financed by a commercial bank from the city centre.
ex.cn: 这座楼由市中心一家商业银行出资兴建。

ex.en: They made a short commercial for a local radio station.
ex.cn: 他们为一家本地电台拍了一则短广告。
ex.note: commercial break 商业广告时段

ex.en: The young composer received a standing ovation after the premiere.
ex.cn: 首演结束后，这位年轻作曲家获得了全场起立鼓掌。

ex.en: The heavy rain confined the students to the classroom.
ex.cn: 大雨把学生们困在了教室里。
ex.note: be confined to 被限制在；confine sb. to bed 让某人卧床休息

ex.en: Construction on the new library began three years ago.
ex.cn: 新图书馆三年前开始动工。

ex.en: He converted the old barn into a small studio.
ex.cn: 他把旧谷仓改建成了一间小工作室。
ex.note: convert A into B 把 A 变成 B；convert dollars into yuan 美元换算成人民币

ex.en: The student council decided to fund the volunteer trip.
ex.cn: 学生会决定出资赞助这次志愿活动。

ex.en: The film crew worked through the night to finish the scene.
ex.cn: 摄制组熬了通宵拍完那个场景。
ex.note: a rescue crew 一支救援队

ex.en: He changed most of his dollars into local currency at the airport.
ex.cn: 他在机场把大部分美元换成了当地货币。

ex.en: Those were the happiest days of his childhood.
ex.cn: 那是他童年中最快乐的日子。
ex.note: in the days of 在…时期；day by day 日复一日

ex.en: If you do not pay the rent, you will be in default.
ex.cn: 如果你不付房租，就算违约。
ex.note: by default 默认情况下

ex.en: The program will default to the standard settings if you change nothing.
ex.cn: 如果你不做任何修改，程序会默认使用标准设置。

ex.en: The landlord asked for a month's rent as a deposit.
ex.cn: 房东要求预付一个月的房租作为押金。

ex.en: She deposited the old photos in a box at the back of the cupboard.
ex.cn: 她把旧照片存进柜子深处的一个盒子里。
ex.note: deposit money into a bank 把钱存入银行

ex.en: There was a devil of a wind on the platform that morning.
ex.cn: 那天早上站台上刮着可怕的大风。
ex.note: a devil of a … 极…的；poor devil 可怜的家伙

ex.en: She gave a direct answer without any small talk.
ex.cn: 她一句寒暄都没有，给了直截了当的回答。

ex.en: A police officer directed the traffic away from the accident.
ex.cn: 一名警察把车辆引离事故现场。
ex.note: be directed to do 被要求做

ex.en: The room was in mild disorder, with books stacked on the bed.
ex.cn: 房间里略显凌乱，书堆在床上。
ex.note: a sleep disorder 睡眠失调

ex.en: A dolphin followed the boat for nearly a mile before it turned back.
ex.cn: 一头海豚跟着船游了近一英里才掉头离开。

ex.en: It had taken him two years to make that dream come true.
ex.cn: 他花了两年时间才让那个梦想成真。
ex.note: come true 实现；a pipe dream 空想

ex.en: I dreamed about the sea all last night.
ex.cn: 昨晚我整晚都梦见了大海。

ex.en: The children were eager to see the sea for the first time.
ex.cn: 孩子们急切地想第一次看到大海。
ex.note: be eager to do 急于做；eager for 渴望

ex.en: The new method is far more efficient than the old one.
ex.cn: 新方法比旧方法高效得多。

ex.en: He embraced his old friend and laughed for a long time.
ex.cn: 他拥抱了老友，笑了很久。
ex.note: embrace a change 欣然接受变化

ex.en: She is doing an engineering course at the university.
ex.cn: 她在大学读工程专业。

ex.en: The prisoner escaped through a window that had been left open.
ex.cn: 囚犯从一扇没关严的窗户逃走了。
ex.note: a narrow escape 险胜；escape from 逃脱

ex.en: The final examination lasts two hours and covers the whole book.
ex.cn: 期末考试持续两小时，涵盖整本书的内容。
ex.note: take/pass an exam 参加/通过考试；medical examination 体检

ex.en: His first month at university was a completely new experience.
ex.cn: 他大学的第一个月是一次全新的经历。

ex.en: Few people have experienced such a long journey by train.
ex.cn: 很少有人经历过这样漫长的火车旅程。
ex.note: have experience in 在…方面有经验

ex.en: The whole faculty gathered in the hall for the opening ceremony.
ex.cn: 全体教职员工聚集在礼堂参加开学典礼。
ex.note: the faculty of law 法学院；a faculty for languages 语言天赋

ex.en: He held his bag fast against his knees and watched the window.
ex.cn: 他把包紧紧抱在膝头，眼睛望着窗外。
ex.note: hold fast 紧握；fast food 快餐

ex.en: The library will be finished before the spring festival.
ex.cn: 图书馆会在春节前竣工。

ex.en: The fishermen went out before dawn and came back with the tide.
ex.cn: 渔民们在破晓前出海，跟着潮水归来。

ex.en: Folk songs filled the bus as the driver turned up the radio.
ex.cn: 司机调大了收音机，车里响起了民歌。
ex.note: folk music 民乐；folk art 民间艺术

ex.en: The museum collected folk paintings from the northern villages.
ex.cn: 博物馆收藏了北方乡村的民间画作。

ex.en: He felt fortunate to have been accepted by the university.
ex.cn: 他觉得能被这所大学录取是件幸运的事。
ex.note: It is fortunate that … 幸好……

ex.en: In the early days the city felt like a frontier town.
ex.cn: 最初那几年，这座城市给人的感觉像一座边陲小镇。
ex.note: the frontier of science 科学的前沿

ex.en: Mark carried the garbage down to the bins behind the dormitory.
ex.cn: 马克把垃圾拎到了宿舍后面的垃圾桶那里。

ex.en: The driver gave each passenger a smile as they found their seats.
ex.cn: 乘客们找到座位时，司机都朝他们笑了一下。
ex.note: give up 放弃；give in 屈服；give away 赠送

ex.en: He grabbed my bag and carried it upstairs before I could object.
ex.cn: 他一把抓起我的行李，没等我反对就提上了楼。

ex.en: He grinned and introduced himself in one long breath.
ex.cn: 他咧嘴一笑，一口气就把自己介绍完了。

ex.en: His mother had packed bread, ham and cold onion into a metal box.
ex.cn: 母亲把面包、火腿和凉洋葱装进了一个铁盒。

ex.en: She is the head of the engineering department.
ex.cn: 她是工程系的系主任。
ex.note: head of state 国家元首

ex.en: The train crew headed for the depot with their cases.
ex.cn: 列车乘务员提着箱子朝车站货场走去。

ex.en: Come here and let me show you what I mean.
ex.cn: 过来，我给你看看我的意思。
ex.note: here and there 到处；here is … 这就是

ex.en: He still missed his homeland, the coast and the wild wind.
ex.cn: 他依然想念故乡，那片海岸和那阵野风。

ex.en: A huge new library was rising behind the old statue.
ex.cn: 老雕像后面，一栋巨大的新图书馆正在拔地而起。

ex.en: A sign warned that it was illegal to beg inside the station.
ex.cn: 一块告示牌写着：站内乞讨属违法行为。

ex.en: The money was kept in a safe place under his books.
ex.cn: 钱被放在他书本下面的一个安全的地方。
ex.note: in the morning 在早上；in 2024 在 2024 年

ex.en: Are you in?
ex.cn: 你在家吗？

ex.en: His father's quiet influence had shaped every choice he had made.
ex.cn: 父亲那种不声不响的影响，塑造了他做过的每一个选择。

ex.en: His teacher influenced him to study engineering.
ex.cn: 是老师影响了他去学工程。

ex.en: Cautious by instinct, David followed the sign instead of the crowd.
ex.cn: 出于本能的谨慎，大卫跟着指示牌走，没有跟着人群。

ex.en: It was an intimate thing to say to someone he had known for only a day.
ex.cn: 这话对只认识一天的人说出口，显得太过私密。

ex.en: He felt a little jealous of her confidence.
ex.cn: 他对她那份自信有些嫉妒。
ex.note: be jealous of 嫉妒

ex.en: The key to success is patience, not talent.
ex.cn: 成功的关键是耐心，而不是天赋。

ex.en: The next month will be key to the whole project.
ex.cn: 下个月对整个项目至关重要。
ex.note: the key to … …的关键

ex.en: Mark spoke of lamb the way city boys spoke of pizza.
ex.cn: 马克谈起羊肉来，就像城里的男孩谈起披萨。

ex.en: The president spoke about leadership and responsibility.
ex.cn: 校长谈到了领导力与责任感。

ex.en: In the liberal arts course the students argued about the origin of language.
ex.cn: 在文科课上，学生们争论着语言的起源。
ex.note: liberal arts 人文/文科；liberal education 通识教育

ex.en: The room was small, with a little kettle on the floor.
ex.cn: 房间不大，地板上放着一只小水壶。
ex.note: a little 一点；little 几乎不（否定）

ex.en: He little understood how much the city would change him.
ex.cn: 他几乎没意识到这座城市会给他带来多大的改变。

ex.en: "I love it here," he said, surprised to find that it was true.
ex.cn: “我很喜欢这里。”他说，惊讶地发现这话是真的。
ex.note: be in love with 爱上；love doing 喜欢做

ex.en: Rebuilding the harbour was the major project of that year.
ex.cn: 重建港口是那一年的主要工程。

ex.en: His major was engineering, and he never once regretted it.
ex.cn: 他的专业是工程学，他从没后悔过。

ex.en: She majors in literature but takes two science courses.
ex.cn: 她主修文学，但选修两门理科课程。

ex.en: David's only vice was sweets; his mate Mark's was loud music.
ex.cn: 大卫唯一的坏毛病是贪吃甜食；他伙伴马克的坏毛病是大声放音乐。

ex.en: He became a member of the volleyball club that week.
ex.cn: 那周他成了排球俱乐部的一员。

ex.en: He changed his mind within a minute of reaching the library.
ex.cn: 他到了图书馆不到一分钟就改了主意。
ex.note: Would you mind doing …? 你介意做…吗？

ex.en: Do you mind if I sit here?
ex.cn: 我坐这儿你介意吗？

ex.en: Moisture gathered on the window during the rain.
ex.cn: 下雨天，窗玻璃上聚起了一层水汽。

ex.en: The physics teacher turned a lecture on movement into a live demonstration.
ex.cn: 物理老师把一堂运动课变成了一场现场演示。

ex.en: Once the choice was made, it felt perfectly natural.
ex.cn: 一旦做出选择，一切就显得那么自然。

ex.en: A new library was rising behind the old statue of the founder.
ex.cn: 老创校人的雕像后面，一座新图书馆正在拔地而起。

ex.en: He left a short note on the kitchen table before he left.
ex.cn: 出门前，他在厨房桌上留了一张便条。

ex.en: She noted the names of all the new students in her notebook.
ex.cn: 她把新同学的名字都记在了笔记本上。
ex.note: note that … 注意到；take note of 留意

ex.en: He obtained his student card in the first week of term.
ex.cn: 他在开学第一周就办好了学生卡。

ex.en: The smell of frying onion filled the small room.
ex.cn: 炸洋葱的香味充满了这间小屋。

ex.en: The students argued about the origin of language for a whole hour.
ex.cn: 学生们为语言的起源争论了整整一个小时。

ex.en: He owed his parents more than he could ever say.
ex.cn: 他亏欠父母的，永远说不清。
ex.note: owe it to sb. that … 多亏了某人…

ex.en: The two beds stood parallel under the window.
ex.cn: 两张床在窗下平行摆着。

ex.en: There is a clear parallel between his first year and his last.
ex.cn: 他的第一年和最后一年之间有明显的相似之处。
ex.note: draw a parallel between 在…之间找出相似点

ex.en: After a pause, Mark spoke into the dark.
ex.cn: 停顿了一下，马克对着黑暗开口。

ex.en: The first period on Tuesday was mathematics.
ex.cn: 周二的第一节课是数学。
ex.note: a period of … 一段时间；in the period of … 在…时期

ex.en: A picture of Mark's family was taped above his desk.
ex.cn: 马克家人的照片用胶带贴在书桌上方。

ex.en: She tried to picture the life she had been dreaming of for two years.
ex.cn: 她试着想象那个自己梦想了两年的生活。

ex.en: Her quick smile pleased everyone in the office.
ex.cn: 她爽朗的微笑让办公室里每个人都心情舒畅。

ex.en: "Please, stir this," Mark said, handing him the spoon.
ex.cn: “请，帮我搅一搅。”马克把勺子递给他。

ex.en: They pooled their money for the week and shared the shopping.
ex.cn: 他们把一周的钱凑在一起花，买东西也各摊一份。

ex.en: Small companies pooled their resources to pay for the new software.
ex.cn: 几家小公司把资源集中起来支付新软件的费用。

ex.en: The crowd poured toward the taxis as soon as the doors opened.
ex.cn: 车门一开，人群就涌向了出租车。

ex.en: His throat felt tight, and he pretended it was the dust.
ex.cn: 他喉咙发紧，却假装那是因为灰尘。

ex.en: Mark produced an onion, two eggs and a little rice from his bag.
ex.cn: 马克从包里掏出一个洋葱、两个鸡蛋和一点米。

ex.en: The local market sells fresh produce from the farms nearby.
ex.cn: 本地市场出售附近农场的新鲜农产品。

ex.en: Her protest about the reading list was accepted with obvious pleasure.
ex.cn: 她对书单提出的异议，被教授显然愉快地接受了。

ex.en: Students protested against the new rule in front of the hall.
ex.cn: 学生们在礼堂前对新规定提出了抗议。

ex.en: The wide range of choices puzzled him at first.
ex.cn: 五花八门的选择一开始让他很困惑。

ex.en: Her answer puzzled everyone in the room.
ex.cn: 她的回答让屋里所有人都摸不着头脑。

ex.en: The range of courses on offer was much wider than he expected.
ex.cn: 可选课程的范围比他预想的宽得多。

ex.en: Prices range from fifty to two hundred yuan.
ex.cn: 价格从五十到两百元不等。
ex.note: range from A to B 从A到B；a wide range of 广泛的

ex.en: At the counter he exchanged some money and received a paper ticket.
ex.cn: 在窗口他换了一些钱，拿到一张纸质车票。

ex.en: He regarded her with a mixture of admiration and envy.
ex.cn: 他看着她，心里既佩服又羡慕。

ex.en: In this regard, the two universities are exactly the same.
ex.cn: 在这方面，这两所大学完全一样。
ex.note: with regard to 关于；in this regard 在这方面

ex.en: Running on the track became his remedy for sleepless nights.
ex.cn: 在跑道上跑步成了他对付失眠的良方。

ex.en: A hot cup of tea remedied the cold he felt after the long walk.
ex.cn: 走了很久之后，一杯热茶治好了他受寒的不适。

ex.en: Local residents complained about the noise from the new bar.
ex.cn: 当地居民抱怨新开酒吧的噪音。

ex.en: The resident advisor said nobody would disturb him.
ex.cn: 宿管顾问说，没人会来打扰他。

ex.en: He said it would be the most revolutionary building on the coast.
ex.cn: 他说，那将是这一带最具突破性的建筑。

ex.en: The open roof of the library looked like the ribs of a tame animal.
ex.cn: 图书馆敞开的屋顶看起来像某种温驯动物的肋骨。

ex.en: He kept his money in a safe place under his books.
ex.cn: 他把钱藏在书本下一个安全的地方。

ex.en: The deposit slip was kept in the small safe in his wardrobe.
ex.cn: 存款单被锁在衣柜里那个小保险箱中。

ex.en: "That is not a scandal," she said. "That is education."
ex.cn: “那不是丑闻，”她说，“那才叫教育。”

ex.en: The rainy season arrived, and with it the damp that made the walls sweat.
ex.cn: 雨季到了，随之而来的是让墙壁渗出汗水的潮气。
ex.note: in season 当季的；the high season 旺季

ex.en: The train arrived on the first Sunday of September.
ex.cn: 火车在九月的第一个星期日抵达。

ex.en: Bicycles were lined up in a long shed behind the dormitory.
ex.cn: 自行车整整齐齐停在宿舍后面的一排棚屋里。

ex.en: The old roof shed water in heavy rain.
ex.cn: 那间旧棚屋在大雨时会漏水。
ex.note: shed light on 阐明

ex.en: He had never been sick on a boat, but the bus was another matter entirely.
ex.cn: 他在船上从没晕过，可坐车完全是另一回事。
ex.note: be sick of 厌倦；sick of 受够了

ex.en: By October, the situation at home had settled, and so had he.
ex.cn: 到了十月，家里的情况稳定下来了，他也是。

ex.en: "You smell of salt," Mark said, laughing.
ex.cn: “你身上有股咸味。”马克笑着说。

ex.en: He could smell frying onion from the stairwell.
ex.cn: 他在楼梯间就闻到了炸洋葱的味道。

ex.en: It was an intimate thing to say to somebody he had known for one day.
ex.cn: 这话对才认识一天的人说出口，显得很私密。

ex.en: He spoke of lamb the way city boys spoke of pizza.
ex.cn: 他说起羊肉，就像城里的男孩说起披萨。
ex.note: speak for 代表…说话；speak of 提到

ex.en: Mark handed him the spoon and asked him to stir the pot.
ex.cn: 马克把勺子递给他，让他搅一搅锅里的东西。

ex.en: A huge new library was rising behind the old statue of the founder.
ex.cn: 老创校人的雕像后面，一座巨大的新图书馆正在拔地而起。

ex.en: On Thursday they cooked their first dinner on the shared stove.
ex.cn: 周四他们在公用炉灶上做了第一顿晚饭。

ex.en: The architecture mixed two centuries and several styles.
ex.cn: 这里的建筑混合了两个世纪、几种风格。

ex.en: On Sunday evenings he called home.
ex.cn: 每个周日晚上他都打电话回家。

ex.en: The noise raised his suspicion that he would never get used to it.
ex.cn: 那噪音让他怀疑自己永远也习惯不了。
ex.note: under suspicion 被怀疑

ex.en: Its open roof looked like the ribs of some tame animal.
ex.cn: 它敞开的屋顶看起来像某种温驯动物张开的肋骨。

ex.en: No one can tame the wind on this coast.
ex.cn: 这片海岸上的风，谁也驯服不了。

ex.en: The train pulled in at ten past seven.
ex.cn: 火车七点十分进站。
ex.note: ten past … …点过（十分）

ex.en: Music, he would learn, was Mark's therapy.
ex.cn: 后来他才明白，音乐是马克的治疗方式。

ex.en: His throat felt tight, and he pretended it was the dust.
ex.cn: 他喉咙发紧，却假装那是因为灰尘。
ex.note: clear one's throat 清清嗓子

ex.en: Today, looking back, he still cannot say which was harder.
ex.cn: 如今回头看，他还是说不清哪件事更难。
ex.note: the day after tomorrow 后天

ex.en: The running track became his remedy for the nights when homesickness came back.
ex.cn: 每当想家的夜里，操场跑道就成了他的良药。

ex.en: The police tracked the stolen bike to an old warehouse.
ex.cn: 警方把被盗自行车追踪到一座旧仓库。
ex.note: keep track of 记录；track down 追查到

ex.en: "The first week is a trial," Mark said.
ex.cn: “第一周是个考验。”马克说。
ex.note: a trial of … 一场…的考验；stand trial 受审

ex.en: Mark produced an onion, two eggs and a little rice from his bag.
ex.cn: 马克从包里掏出一个洋葱、两个鸡蛋和一点米。

ex.en: They were given their course units and a map of the campus.
ex.cn: 他们领到了学分表和一张校园地图。

ex.en: The utility bill for the dormitory, split three ways, was his first real expense.
ex.cn: 宿舍那份三人平摊的水电费，是他第一笔真正自己花的钱。

ex.en: David's only vice was sweets; his mate Mark's was loud music.
ex.cn: 大卫唯一的坏毛病是贪吃甜食；他伙伴马克的坏毛病是大声放音乐。

ex.en: He joined the volleyball club, though he was badly coordinated.
ex.cn: 他加入了排球俱乐部，尽管肢体协调得很糟糕。

ex.en: We pooled our money for the week and shared the shopping.
ex.cn: 我们把一周的钱凑在一起花，买东西也各摊一份。

ex.en: "What do you think of it?" his mother asked the first time.
ex.cn: “你觉得怎么样？”母亲第一次问。
ex.note: What a pity! 真可惜！

ex.en: He still missed the coast and the wild wind of his childhood.
ex.cn: 他依然想念故乡的海岸和那阵野风。

ex.en: The settlers pushed deep into the wild.
ex.cn: 拓荒者深入荒野腹地。

ex.en: Workmen in yellow helmets were everywhere on the site.
ex.cn: 工地上到处都是戴黄色安全帽的工人。

ex.en: "Yes," his father said, "that is what we hoped."
ex.cn: “是啊，”父亲说，“这正是我们希望的。”
